description:
Whether healing acts, the strikes and grace it acts after, every unhealthy item of the
latest pass, what could not be reached, and the newest runs.

classified_at.description:
When the latest pass classified the queue, in seconds since the Unix epoch, where
one ever has.

grace_s.description: How long a newly added download is left alone, in seconds.

healing.description: Whether healing acts, or only classifies.

incomplete.description: Whether the list may be short, because something could not be read.

items.description: Every unhealthy item the latest pass found; a healthy one is left out.

mismatch.description:
Where a download client files a curator's downloads outside the curator's folder,
which nothing is acted on past.

rehearsed.description: Whether this answer is a run that only said what it would do.

runs.description: The newest runs first, each a pass that could act, rehearsed or not.

strikes_needed.description: How many consecutive passes flag an item for one reason before it is acted on.

unreachable.description: Every curator or download client the latest pass could not reach or verify.
